topics.summary: 原创微型任务，分别检验原文定位与未提及/否定逻辑。

common_error_patterns.description: 候选原因，需独立证据验证。

common_error_patterns.name: 相关原文定位困难
common_error_patterns.description: 候选原因，需独立证据验证。

materials.title: initial
materials.content_body: The town library opens at nine on weekdays. Members may borrow six books.

materials.title: locate
materials.content_body: [1] The museum opens at ten. [2] Backpacks must be left in lockers. [3] Tickets are sold online.

materials.title: logic
materials.content_body: Relevant evidence: The research team measured water temperature in July. No other measurement dates are described.

materials.title: practice-logic
materials.content_body: The ferry runs every Monday. Tuesday services are not discussed.

materials.title: practice-location
materials.content_body: [1] Classes begin at eight. [2] Registration closes on Friday. [3] Bring a pencil.

questions.prompt_text: The library opens at nine on Sundays. Choose TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
questions.answer_explanation: Only weekday opening is specified; Sunday opening is not stated.

evaluation_rubric.purpose: 初始错误仅触发竞争假设
evaluation_rubric.evidence_scope: Only weekday opening is specified; Sunday opening is not stated.

candidate_error_mappings.evidence_summary: 该选择与候选原因相容，但单题无法区分原因。

evaluation_rubric.purpose: 隔离定位能力：无需 TFNG 推断，只找相关句
evaluation_rubric.discriminating_rationale: 先用新短文定位任务检验定位能力，避免把 TFNG 逻辑错误与定位错误混在一起。

diagnostic_evidence_mappings.summary: 本次独立微任务表现与该候选原因不一致；单题不能排除。

questions.prompt_text: Statement: The team measured water temperature in December. Use only the supplied evidence.
questions.answer_explanation: July measurement does not establish or deny December measurement.

evaluation_rubric.purpose: 直接提供证据范围，减少定位负担，单独检验未提及与否定逻辑
evaluation_rubric.evidence_scope: July measurement does not establish or deny December measurement.
evaluation_rubric.discriminating_rationale: 直接给出相关证据，检验未提及与明确否定的逻辑区别；与前一道定位题合并判断。

diagnostic_evidence_mappings.summary: 本次独立微任务表现与该候选原因不一致；单题不能排除。
本次独立微任务表现与该候选原因相容；尚未确认。

questions.answer_explanation: Monday operation neither establishes nor denies Tuesday operation.

evaluation_rubric.purpose: 练习识别没有提供的信息
evaluation_rubric.evidence_scope: Monday operation neither establishes nor denies Tuesday operation.
